protocol.authorship: Independently authored native core fixtures; raw records are fictional benchmark material, not owner archive data.
protocol.split_rule: Entire basin group assigned development; entire gallery group assigned validation before any method execution.
protocol.read_boundary: Only repository instructions, native headers/serializers, and API-only messages consulted; no author tests, existing independent cases, synthetic_dev, or real holdout key read.
protocol.native_identity: IDs follow native prefixes plus first 16 lowercase SHA256 hex characters of unit-separator joined native identity parts, using sorted compact UTF-8 JSON.
protocol.scope_and_modality: Scope uses native qualifiers.scope and explicit Entity.parent; quotation, uncertainty, and negation use exact qualifiers.extra annotations with no claim that the core has dedicated fields for them.
protocol.observed_semantics: All claim assessments are observed source statements with located support. The fixture separately states whether the source is direct, attributed, uncertain, world-negated, or epistemically negated.
protocol.independence_semantics: The benchmark independently authors acquisition A and B; source cardinality is a provenance count, not a general proof of epistemic independence.
protocol.hash_rule: frozen_sha256 is SHA256 of canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON of this root object with frozen_sha256 omitted; external full-file SHA256 is recorded separately.
protocol.prohibited_adaptation: Do not change case content, split, expected annotations, or relationships after viewing projection or scoring outcomes.

Basin α — rig notes
  During the basin trial, the estuary sluice limits the tidal flow.
	During the basin trial, the estuary sluice limits the tidal flow.

Basin α — rig notes / acquisition B
An independent gauge recorded that, during the basin trial, the estuary sluice limits the tidal flow.

Basin α — rig notes / quoted
	Mara said, “The estuary sluice limits the tidal flow.”

Basin α — rig notes / possible
	The estuary sluice may limit the tidal flow; the gauge was unreadable.

Basin α — rig notes / relation_negated
	During the basin trial, the estuary sluice does not limit the tidal flow.

Basin α — rig notes / epistemic_negated
	It is not established that the estuary sluice limits the tidal flow.

Basin α — rig notes / narrow_scope
	During the low-tide segment of the basin trial, the estuary sluice limits the tidal flow.

Gallery β — inspection notes
  During the gallery inspection, the east gallery shutter blocks the morning light.
	During the gallery inspection, the east gallery shutter blocks the morning light.

Gallery β — inspection notes / acquisition B
A separately positioned light meter recorded that, during the gallery inspection, the east gallery shutter blocks the morning light.

Gallery β — inspection notes / quoted
	Ivo said, “The east gallery shutter blocks the morning light.”

Gallery β — inspection notes / possible
	The east gallery shutter may block the morning light; the light meter was unreadable.

Gallery β — inspection notes / relation_negated
	During the gallery inspection, the east gallery shutter does not block the morning light.

Gallery β — inspection notes / epistemic_negated
	It is not established that the east gallery shutter blocks the morning light.

Gallery β — inspection notes / narrow_scope
	During the upper-pane inspection within the gallery inspection, the east gallery shutter blocks the morning light.
